deploy-bot: [DEPLOY START] multi-service fanout initiating for PROD
deploy-bot: env=prod change_window=2026-03-19T22:00Z -> 2026-03-19T23:00Z; user=release-engineering; ticket=REL-988
deploy-bot: services=runtime@v1.12.3(sha:abcde123) api@v2.4.0(sha:f12a4b6) console@canary-5(sha:9f8e7d6)
deploy-bot: rollout=staggered-canary; order=[runtime -> api -> console]; canary_duration=10m; canary_traffic=5%
alex: On it. I saw a perf spike in the last internal run of runtime@v1.12.3 on long sequences. Can we hold the runtime canary until we confirm no reg? :mag_right:
sam: I'll tail runtime logs and metrics. dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/prod/runtime
maria: +1 on the spike. I recommend pinning runtime to the previous build for the initial canary: runtime@v1.12.2 (sha:98bc321). We can test 1.12.3 in a separate non-prod rollout.
alex: Agreed. Rollout engineering: please update runtime tag to v1.12.2 for this fanout and proceed with canary. We still proceed with api@v2.4.0 and console canary as planned.
deploy-bot: Received request: modify service runtime -> runtime@v1.12.2(sha:98bc321). New plan applied. Rolling out now.
ops-bot: Change window reminder in 5m. Compliance note: ensure audit-log tag REL-988 attached.
jin: Kicking off runtime canary (pinned v1.12.2). Will monitor p50/p95/p99 and model latency traces.
deploy-bot: [RUNTIME CANARY STARTED] runtime@v1.12.2 -> 5% traffic at 1792005065
sam: seeing stable p95 so far, no OOMs. CPU spiky at 70% but holding.
maria: running a short prompt set against the canary for quality regressions.
deploy-bot: [RUNTIME CANARY COMPLETE] 10m elapsed. metrics: p95 +2% vs baseline, errors 0. Can continue -> promoting runtime to 50%.
alex: promote to 50% then api canary start.
deploy-bot: Promoting runtime -> 50% at 1792005180
deploy-bot: [API CANARY STARTED] api@v2.4.0 (sha:f12a4b6) -> 5% traffic
sam: API latencies look fine. No increased 500s. Traces linked: https://tracing.redwood/trace/REL-988
maria: console canary is low-risk but will hold for post-api check.
deploy-bot: [API CANARY COMPLETE] 10m elapsed. errors: 2 minor timeouts on an endpoint, rolled to retry path. Overall pass.
alex: Those timeouts were from a downstream cache warmup, expected. Good to roll console canary.
jin: launching console canary now.
deploy-bot: [CONSOLE CANARY STARTED] console@canary-5 -> 5% traffic
sam: console JS bundle served fine. No Sentry errors yet.
deploy-bot: [CONSOLE CANARY FAILED] 6m elapsed. Error rate spike on console assets 502s from CDN. Details: cdn-edge misconfig, likely cache purge race.
maria: Reverting console to previous stable (console@stable-4) for now. pin and rollback console.
alex: Agreed. Revert console canary. Keep runtime/api promoted.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback: console -> console@stable-4(sha:44aa33) at 1792005299
ops-bot: Noted rollback. Attached incident draft: INC-REL-1792005299
sam: After rollback, let's re-run a console canary with a different CDN header to avoid purge race.
jin: Will schedule a mid-week redeploy with a staggered cache key and a smaller canary.
alex: Thanks everyone. Final state: runtime @ v1.12.2 promoted (50% -> continue autoscale), api @ v2.4.0 promoted, console rolled back to stable-4. I'll update release notes: https://confluence.redwood/rel/REL-988/notes
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY COMPLETE] fanout finished with partial rollback at 1792005312. Summary: runtime pinned->promoted, api promoted, console rolled back. Audit: REL-988.
